name: Page start
responsibility: Starts this page's renderer and hands the viewer its picture source and cache once; learns the vault the server serves before the application renders, or replays a recorded talk

outgoing.description: At page start, the viewer takes its pictures from this page's own source, once. The page or replay imports the semantic-board-canvas root. It re-exports takePicturesFrom from the implementing child, so the relationship ends on that public entry point.
At page start, this page's renderer is fetched and started.
A page opened to replay a recorded talk starts the replay instead of the application.

At page start, the source that draws pictures in this page is made from its renderer and storage. The page or replay imports the semantic-board-canvas root. It re-exports createLocalPictureSource from the implementing child, so the relationship ends on that public entry point.

At page start, this browser's store for kept pictures is opened. The page or replay imports the semantic-board-canvas root. It re-exports browserPictureStorage from the implementing child, so the relationship ends on that public entry point.
